branches.conclusion: The current inventory establishes a Doctor of Philosophy Programme in Accounting and Business Management. Its expanded programme information establishes original independent research and a PhD awarded by Hong Kong Baptist University, but the information and coursework sections read do not establish an Operations doctoral specialization or explicit research-field mapping.

The complete research postgraduate inventory and expanded programme descriptions for Applied Mathematics, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, and Computer Science and Technology were read. None establishes an explicit Operations, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management or Logistics doctoral field. Generic engineering applications and project-management skills are not treated as such a field.

sources.note: Read the complete nine-subject research postgraduate inventory: Accounting and Business Management, Economics, Communication, Applied English Linguistics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science and Technology, Probability and Mathematical Statistics, and Applied Mathematics.

Read the business programme page, expanded Programme Information and Coursework Arrangement sections. Explicit independent original doctoral research and award by Hong Kong Baptist University were read; no Operations field was established.

Read the expanded Programme Information: probability and statistics research includes multivariate statistics, high-dimensional data analysis, time series, machine learning and experimental design. No explicit Operations doctoral field was established.

Read the expanded Programme Information, Introduction, Objective and Teaching Resources. Research fields include AI, machine learning, data science, vision, NLP, robotics, autonomous driving, quantum finance, program trading, visualization, graphics and software. limitations: The Accounting and Business Management doctoral programme has verified research-doctorate status, but an explicit Operations field or specialization has not been established. Its field mapping remains unresolved. BNBU delivery and the explicitly stated Hong Kong Baptist University award are preserved separately; this does not merge the two institutions.
